title: 第21章 李夫子的反击上门抓捕沈浪第22章 锦衣卫小旗沈浪就算计你了咋滴
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
半个时辰后。
皇宫，养心殿内。
一身飞鱼服的高大男子，单膝跪地，冲着神霄行礼：“卑职徐达拜见陛下！”
看到锦衣卫指挥使徐达来了，神霄也是笑着挥手：
“徐叔，您是看着我长大的，咱们间就不要客气了，快起来吧！”
听到这话，徐达憨厚的站起身，笑着询问道：
“陛下，您此番召卑职前来，是有什么事情要交代吗？”
神霄点头：“我遇到了一个奇人，给我出了一个可以抓住刺杀我父皇凶手的计策，我觉得很不错，打算让你去配合他演好这场戏！”
“同时，也将他招进锦衣卫，好生培养！”
“真的？”
听到这话，徐达的眼中立刻流露出激动之色。
毕竟，自从上任国主被刺杀之后，他们锦衣卫在文武百官面前可谓是丢尽了脸面。
甚至就连他，都不好意思主动来找神霄汇报工作，生怕神霄会问他，抓捕刺客的进展。
没想到，就在他愁眉不展的时候，竟然会有奇人，帮他解决这个问题。
这使得徐达忍不住的询问道：“敢问陛下，是什么方法？”
“是……”
神霄没有迟疑，立刻将沈浪的计划，全都告诉了徐达。
听完全套计划的徐达，眼中也泛起了精光：“妙啊，真的是妙不可言呐！”
“敢问陛下，这是哪个大家族培养出来的绝代天骄？”

“他的家族能同意这样的绝代天骄，加入咱们锦衣卫吗？”
神霄笑着点头：“他可不是大家族子弟，只是一个应天府的小衙役，叫做沈浪！”
“沈浪？！”
听到这个名字，徐达猛然一惊。
他的反应，顿时让神霄蹙眉：“你知道他？”
“卑职也是刚知道的！”徐达神色无比凝重道：“刚刚下面的人来消息说，李夫子去了应天府状告沈浪偷盗圣人墨宝，请应天府抓捕此贼！”
砰！
神霄听完，猛地一巴掌，拍在了御书案上，
大骂道：“妈的，李悠那个老匹夫，简直是欺人太甚！！！”
眼见神霄竟然罕见的爆了粗口，徐达的脸上也是浮现出了震惊之色。
毕竟，他是看着神霄长大了。
对于神霄是什么性格，喜好做什么事情，可谓是一清二楚。
若是他没有记错的话，神霄最喜欢的不就是舞文弄墨了吗？
甚至李悠那个老匹夫还是神霄敬佩的对象。
这怎么突然间，神霄跟李悠间，就好似是有血海深仇一般？
想不通的徐达，一脸疑惑的询问道：“陛下，何出此言呀？”
“那副圣人墨宝，乃是沈浪所写，是我拿到李夫子那边，请他在朝堂上提沈浪入朝为官之事的！”
“没想到那个老匹夫竟然是镇北王的人，强行说那副字是他们北冥书院的！”
“什么？！”
听完神霄的解释，徐达的眼珠子差点没有瞪出来。

显然他做梦也没有想到，这件事竟然还夹杂着那么多的故事。
意识到，此事或许是镇北王反击的徐达，立刻眯起眼道：
“陛下，若是这样的话，咱们怕是得抓紧去救那沈浪，否则凭借镇北王那帮家伙的性格，必然会将沈浪屈打成招！”

Half an hour later.
In the palace, inside the Yangxin Hall.
A tall man in Feiyu uniform knelt on one knee and saluted to the sky: "Xu Da, a humble official, pays homage to your majesty!"
Seeing Jinyiwei commander Xu Da coming, Shenxiao also smiled and waved:
"Uncle Xu, you have watched me grow up, so don't be polite between us, get up quickly!"
Hearing this, Xu Da stood up honestly and asked with a smile:
"Your Majesty, do you have anything to explain to me when you call me here?"
Shen Xiao nodded: "I met a strange man who gave me a plan to catch the murderer of my father. I think it's very good, and I plan to let you cooperate with him in this scene!"
"At the same time, we will also recruit him into the Jinyi Guards and train him well!"
"Really?"
Hearing this, Xu Da's eyes immediately showed excitement.
After all, since the previous king was assassinated, their royal guards have been completely humiliated in front of the civil and military officials.
Even he was embarrassed to take the initiative to report to Shen Xiao, for fear that Shen Xiao would ask him about the progress of catching the assassin.
Unexpectedly, just when he was frowning, there would be a strange person to help him solve this problem.
This made Xu Da couldn't help but ask: "May I ask Your Majesty, what is the method?"
"Yes..."
Shen Xiao did not hesitate and immediately told Xu Da all about Shen Lang's plan.
After hearing the complete plan, Xu Da's eyes also shone with light: "Wonderful, it's really wonderful!"
"May I ask Your Majesty, which great family cultivated this peerless talent?"
"Can his family agree to such a unique genius joining our Jin Yiwei?"
Shen Xiao smiled and nodded: "He is not a member of a big family, he is just a small yamen servant of Yingtian Mansion, his name is Shen Lang!"
"Shen Lang?!"
Hearing this name, Xu Da was suddenly startled.
His reaction immediately made Shen Xiao frown: "Do you know him?"
"I just found out about my humble position!" Xu Da said with an extremely solemn expression: "The people below just came with news that Master Li went to Yingtian Mansion to sue Shen Lang for stealing the saint's calligraphy treasure. Please Yingtian Mansion arrest the thief!"
Bang!
After hearing this, Shen Xiao slapped the imperial book desk with a sudden slap.
Cursed: "Damn, that old man Li You is just too much of a bully!!!"
Seeing Shen Xiao's rare swearing, Xu Da also had a look of shock on his face.
After all, he watched Shen Xiao grow up.
He knew very clearly what kind of character Shen Xiao was and what he liked to do.
If he remembers correctly, isn't Shenxiao's favorite thing about writing and writing?
Even that old man Li You is still the object of Shenxiao's admiration.
Why is it that suddenly, there seems to be a blood feud between Shen Xiao and Li You?
Xu Da, who couldn't figure it out, asked with a puzzled face: "Your Majesty, why did you say this?"
"That piece of saint's calligraphy was written by Shen Lang. I brought it to Master Li and asked him to mention Shen Lang's appointment as an official in the court!"
"I didn't expect that old man to be a member of the Zhenbei King. He forcefully said that the calligraphy was from their Beiming Academy!"
"What?!"
After hearing Shen Xiao's explanation, Xu Da's eyes almost popped out of his head.
Obviously he never dreamed that there would be so many stories involved in this matter.
Xu Da, who realized that this might be a counterattack by King Zhenbei, immediately narrowed his eyes and said:
"Your Majesty, if this is the case, we must rush to rescue Shen Lang. Otherwise, with the character of Zhenbei King and his gang, they will definitely beat Shen Lang into submission!"
